title: MVDream: Multi-view Diffusion for 3D Generation
layout_note: Three columns on one horizontal axis - 3D model, a 2x2 set of rendered views, the multi-view UNet - with the UNet's block opened in a small panel above it and timestep and camera entering from below.
grouping: A dashed rounded frame holds the four rendered views as one sample; a light lavender panel above the UNet holds its opened block (ResBlock, 3D SelfAttention, CrossAttention); no other containers.
shapes_depth: Flat: the UNet is a light-grey hourglass with white rounded bars outlined in blue; modules and inputs are light-grey rounded rectangles; the 3D model is a shaded 3-D render ringed by grey camera icons; the views are grey-background render tiles.
proposed_highlight: Inside the opened UNet block only '3D SelfAttention' is filled blue with a blue border, between grey ResBlock and CrossAttention; the two uses of the model are named by coloured arrow labels ('Multi-view Generation' blue, '3D Generation' green).
lesson: When one model is trained and then used in the opposite direction, put the shared data between them and run the two uses as opposite-pointing arrows of two colours on the same axis.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v4 PDF's first pages state no venue; the candidate list gives ICLR 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. Fig. 3 (training with image and multi-view modes, plus Multi-view DreamBooth) was judged weaker: long input wires along the panel edges straight into the losses and the right panel recoloured orange throughout.

arrangement.units: no lanes; a dashed rounded frame groups the 2x2 rendered views, and a lavender panel above the UNet opens one block, tied by a dashed line
arrangement.inputs_as: a rendered 3-D robot with camera icons around it, and its four rendered views as image tiles; Text, Timestep and Camera are plain labelled boxes
arrangement.losses_at: not drawn as elements: 'Training Loss' and 'Score Distillation' are labels on the arrows between the rendered views and the UNet
arrangement.shared: the UNet is drawn once at the right; the training arrow enters it and the score-distillation arrow leaves it on the same side

taxonomy.task: text-to-3D generation by score distillation from a camera-conditioned multi-view diffusion UNet trained on rendered views

core.what: 3D model -> 2x2 rendered views -> multi-view UNet on one horizontal axis, read left to right by a blue training arrow and right to left by a green score-distillation arrow, with the rendered view set drawn as data in the middle

relations.form: three columns left to right with paired blue (rightward) and green (leftward) arrows between each, so both uses run along the same axis in opposite directions
one UNet bar is tied by a dashed line to a lavender panel above holding ResBlock -> 3D SelfAttention -> CrossAttention stacked top to bottom
Timestep and Camera boxes join at a circled plus below the UNet and enter its bottom; a Text box feeds CrossAttention from the left inside the opened block

channels.colour: use: blue = training / multi-view generation, green = 3D generation by score distillation; blue also fills the new 3D SelfAttention block and outlines the UNet bars, so blue carries a second meaning (the model and its new part)
channels.shape: hourglass = the UNet, rounded grey rectangles = modules and conditioning inputs, render tiles = data, camera icons = viewpoints, circled plus = addition
channels.line: solid coloured arrows = the two uses; thin black arrows = conditioning; a thin dashed line = callout to the opened block
channels.frame: dashed rounded frame = one multi-view sample; lavender panel = the opened UNet block

quality.strengths: The multi-view sample that both uses exchange is drawn as an actual 2x2 grid of renders between the 3D model and the UNet; training and distillation are opposite arrows on one axis, coloured and labelled per use; the only new module, 3D SelfAttention, is the only filled block in the opened UNet block; camera reaches the UNet by a short straight wire through a circled plus.
quality.weaknesses: Blue marks both the training direction and the UNet / new attention block. The 3D model render is the largest element though the contribution (the attention change) sits in a small corner panel. The two small arrows between the 3D model and the views are unlabelled, and neither loss is drawn as an element - only as arrow labels.

insights.structure: Three columns on one axis (3D model, a dashed-framed 2x2 view grid, the UNet hourglass) with the UNet's block opened in a panel above and conditioning boxes below.
insights.data: The 3D asset is a shaded render ringed by camera icons and the training sample is four rendered views in a 2x2 grid; text, timestep and camera are plain labelled boxes.
insights.emphasis: Inside the opened block only 3D SelfAttention is filled blue; the two uses carry coloured labels on their arrows.
insights.flow: Blue arrows point right from the 3D model through the views into the UNet, green arrows point back left; conditioning enters the UNet from below and the text from the left of the opened block.
insights.avoid: Do not reuse the training-direction colour for the new module, and do not leave the largest area to the routine input render while the contribution sits in a corner.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
